content:
The **Foundation Supply Room** is an unmarked location within Foundation in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

This building is where all supplies going in and out of Foundation are processed, including the wares sold at Sunny's shops. [1] 

The supply room is located in the south east corner of Foundation, below a barracks building, with the entrance on a small stilted platform. Upon entering the interior, there is a security cage to the right which is filled with miscellaneous supplies stored in barrels and crates. In the center of the room sit a series of bookshelves, a table with several folding chairs, and a small section for Sunny the cat. There are two offices on either side of the main room, both protected with a security door.

The Foundation Supply Room appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Steel Dawn* update.

This location was created by Steve Massey. [Dev 1]
